rules.title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy
rules.requirement: Housing providers receiving DND funding or land, or with BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy income-restricted units, may not use blanket bans on applicants with arrests or convictions and must not consider non-conviction arrests, judicially relieved convictions, juvenile records, or convictions over 5 years old (except with a direct relationship to the housing or unreasonable risk to others). Credit scores may not be used to approve or deny applications; credit history may be used only in lieu of rental history.
rules.key_value: No consideration of convictions more than 5 years old; no use of credit scores
rules.citation: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (DND, February 2017)
rules.status_basis: Policy document states housing providers agree to its terms; no adoption date given.

requires.name: public_funding_or_inclusionary_designation
requires.text: Housing providers receiving DND funding and/or land, or with income restricted units created under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy

coverage.summary: Applies to housing receiving DND funding or land or inclusionary income-restricted units.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Does not apply where there is a direct relationship between a conviction and the housing or unreasonable risk to others, or to current criminal behavior; conflicting federal or state law preempts.

precedence.text: Where federal or state law imposes a criminal history requirement that conflicts with a requirement of this guidance, the federal or state law preempts this policy.

rules.quoted_span: Housing providers will consider applicants on a case-by-case basis.
